pages.text: Clocks deep in a gravity well run slow: by $(thing)1/√(1 − r_s/r)$() at a distance r from a mass with Schwarzschild radius r_s.

The $(item)Time Dilation Chamber$() holds samples round a dense core. Set its mass and how close they sit: at three times dilation it grows Time-Dilated Samples in bulk; radium ages into polonium; at five, liquid spacetime is strained into $(fluid)Strained Spacetime$(). Too close and they fall through the horizon. Each storey (1 to 7) holds more.
